name: @srah_x64/theoldllm-provider
description: OpenCode v2 provider plugin for TheOldLLM's OpenAI-compatible API — model metadata, cost multipliers, reasoning variants, and daily quota tracking
author: sRaH

scripts.verify: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then((m) => { const p = m.default; if (p?.id !== 'theoldllm.provider' || typeof p?.setup !== 'function') throw new Error('bad plugin shape'); console.log('plugin ok:', p.id) })"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify
